author: Bloodoh
body:
Then, i was wondering if there can be Security Cameras, like an account who is all the day recording different zones of the server, and record with the Replay Mod (https://www.replaymod.com/). This is a weird idea but it will good to try if this is good.
The mods who are not online at the day can check the video after the day, week, or whatever.

replies.author: Eteh
replies.body: As mentioned by many above, it would take a lot of storage space and time into finding these hackers. I don't think any staff member would have the amount of storage space to store the large replay mod clip and I don't think any staff member would have the time to look at a 24 hour+- clip.

replies.author: _Jupiter
replies.body: This could work if you could jump to a specific time and the footage was on a 24hr loop - if it wasn't saved after 24 hours it would be deleted, like a dashcam. I don't see how this would work for spectating an individual player, though. There would have to be tons of different angles in order to see the alleged hacker.
